description: This script analyzes other source files to find restricted function calls related to webhook body parsing, mainly focusing on security-sensitive handlers. It imports various utility modules and defines functions to identify and report on specific call expressions within the source code.

methods.name: findBlockedWebhookBodyReadLines
methods.description: Analyzes a source code string to find call expressions that invoke blocked functions like 'readJsonBodyWithLimit' or 'readRequestBodyWithLimit' and returns the lines where these calls occur.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that runs the callsite guard to detect forbidden webhook body reads based on predefined rules and configuration.

methods.name: getCalleeName
methods.description: Extracts the callee function name from a call expression, whether it's an identifier or a property access expression.
